author: Martin Domin
title: Anthony Joshua reiterates Jake Paul 'kill' comments after Tyson Fury criticism - NewsBreak
text:
By Martin Domin ,
42 minutes ago
Carlos Alcaraz of Spain and his coach, Juan Carlos Ferrero, before his match in the Men's Singles Round against Jannik Sinner of Italy on day eight of the Nitto ATP Finals 2025 .
Anthony Joshua has defended his controversial "licence to kill" remark, which he made in the wake of criticism from Tyson Fury for stating that Jake Paul is putting his life on the line this weekend.
Joshua , a former heavyweight world champion, is set to face off against YouTube sensation Paul in a professional bout in Miami this Friday.
Earlier in the week, Joshua's comment about potentially 'killing' Paul drew backlash from his long-time adversary Fury , but Joshua stood firm on his statement last night.
"It's my job, we fight. We have a licence to kill," he asserted. "I'm sure many people don't understand it but this is what my job is. I just enjoy what I do. Whatever happens, happens - as long as my hand is raised, that's what's important, respectfully. That's just what the mentality we have to have as fighters. I don't know if other fighters think that way. Maybe they're a bit more tame.
"The way my mind works. When you're in the ring, it's a dangerous thing. Anything can happen. You hope your opponent leaves the ring safely, but if they don't, you still have to go to bed knowing you just did your job. It wasn't personal."
Paul and Joshua will meet on Friday in Miami Carlos Alcaraz of Spain and his coach, Juan Carlos Ferrero, before his match in the Men's Singles Round against Jannik Sinner of Italy on day eight of the Nitto ATP Finals 2025 .
Earlier, Fury, who is currently negotiating a potential match with Joshua next year, slammed his rival's bold claim. "I've been sent a video of Anthony Joshua talking about killing somebody in a boxing ring," he remarked,
"He's a little bit long in the tooth to be talking s---- like that. He's 37 years old [Joshua is 36], at the end of his career fighting a YouTuber, a Disney Channel guy who [Tyson's brother] Tommy beat.
"And now he's talking about killing him and all that to try and sell the fight; he's barking up the wrong tree. Here's a fun fact, if I ever come across you, bum, I'm knocking you dead spark out.
"I ain't a YouTuber or a man half your size, I am him, the man. You're a classless loser, coming off a 15-month knockout defeat to a local lad [Daniel Dubois]. Imagine if someone from Morecambe knocked me out. I can't wait if Jake Paul knocks you spark out, you big bum."
